card.name: First subsection number in label headings
card.fires_on: The digit after the dot in a section number such as 7.1, 5.1 or 2.1, right before the subsection title in a drug label. It also fires on the end of the word Precautions in a '5.1 Warnings and Precautions' heading.

modes.label: Subsection number
modes.description: The digit (mostly 1) after the dot in a numbered label heading, just before the title.

modes.label: Precautions in heading
modes.description: The ending of 'Precautions' in a 5.1 heading.

card.plain: It marks the number of a subsection in a drug label's table of contents, such as 7.1 before a heading.
